# cubepath_object_storage_replications (Data Source)

Lists the Object Storage replications of the organization: outgoing (from your buckets) and incoming (into your buckets from another organization), newest first.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Replications from your buckets and into them from other organizations
data "cubepath_object_storage_replications" "all" {}

# Only the replications that write into one bucket
data "cubepath_object_storage_replications" "incoming" {
  direction   = "incoming"
  bucket_uuid = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}

output "failing_replications" {
  value = [for r in data.cubepath_object_storage_replications.all.replications : r.uuid if r.health == "failing"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `bucket_uuid` (String) Only the replications whose source (outgoing) or destination (incoming) is this bucket.
- `direction` (String) outgoing, incoming or all (default). With all, a replication between two buckets of your organization is listed once, as outgoing.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier.
- `replications` (List of Object) The replications. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--replications))

<a id="nestedatt--replications"></a>
### Nested Schema for `replications`

Read-Only:

- `backfill_bytes` (Number) Bytes copied by the backfills.
- `backfill_objects` (Number) Objects copied by the backfills.
- `backfill_status` (String) none, queued, running, completed or failed.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `delete_marker_replication` (Boolean) Whether delete markers are replicated.
- `delete_replication` (Boolean) Whether deletes of a specific version are replicated.
- `destination_bucket` (String) external: bucket name.
- `destination_bucket_name` (String) cubepath: destination bucket name.
- `destination_bucket_uuid` (String) cubepath: destination bucket UUID.
- `destination_endpoint` (String) external: endpoint host.
- `destination_organization_name` (String) cubepath: organization of the destination bucket.
- `destination_provider` (String) external: aws, wasabi or other.
- `destination_region` (String) external: region.
- `destination_type` (String) cubepath or external.
- `direction` (String) outgoing or incoming.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the replication rule is enabled.
- `existing_objects` (Boolean) Whether the objects the bucket already held are copied.
- `health` (String) unknown, ok, lagging or failing.
- `health_reason` (String) Reason of a failing health.
- `pause_reason` (String) Why it is paused, if it is.
- `prefix` (String) Prefix filter, if any.
- `source_bucket_name` (String) Source bucket name.
- `source_bucket_uuid` (String) Source bucket UUID (null for an incoming replication of another organization).
- `source_organization_name` (String) Organization of the source bucket.
- `status` (String) pending, active, paused, suspended, error or deleting.
- `uuid` (String) Replication UUID.
